address: # Constructors defined IN-CLASS in a header while carrying a // FUNCTION marker.
# a constructor is defined in-class IF AND ONLY IF the original has no standalone body
# for it. A ctor that owns an address stays out-of-line so that body pairs.
# Every in-class definition that still owns an address is therefore a deliberate
# exception and must be listed here with what it bought and what it cost. `outcome`
# is `traded` when the address went unpaired as a result, `free` when VC5 still emits
# the out-of-line copy and nothing was lost.

justification: TItemOrder::CreateObject 41.18% -> 100.00% (its CreateObject absorbs the base ctor: no call, no EH frame). Cost: 0x004b4f00 unpaired, one real caller in the original (InitializeCityProductionState 0x004b2a00). Net +7 exact for the batch.

Measured 2026-07-23 in docs/toolchain.md: in-class keeps 0x4be0d0 and 0x4be840 at 100% (a 31-byte ctor is the prize); out-of-line drops them to 46.15% and 73.68% to recover 0x4be1d0. The three arrangements are mutually exclusive.

Body is byte-identical to TSortedList's ctor (0x004a8640) apart from the final vptr (0x64c9a0 vs 0x648ee0) -- sibling classes, both TObject + CPtrList(10) at +0x4. It has ZERO xrefs, so no call site could gain from out-of-line; every use is an inlined construction site. The TSortedList A/B above also shows TArmyStackList::CreateObject dropping 100->83.02 when its base goes out-of-line. In-class stays.

MEASURED both ways. Out-of-line pairs 0x004a8640 (+1 paired, coverage +0.01pp) but costs 7 exact functions: TTaskList::TTaskList 100->42.86, TSortedList::CreateObject 100->46.15, TList::CreateObject and TArmyStackList::CreateObject 100->83.02, TCityInteriorMinister::InitializeCityInteriorState 95.56->66.86. The two out-of-line callers (TrimExcessNavyOrderSupportAndRebuildOrderBuffer 0x004a6f3e, InitializeNationStateRuntimeSubsystems 0x004d8d6b) are far outnumbered by inlined construction sites. In-class stays.
In-class and still emitted out-of-line: 0x00572b30 pairs at 100.00%. No trade was made.

Measured both placements. Out-of-line does NOT pair either -- reccmp reports 'Failed to find a match at address 0x48a750', because once every caller inlines the ctor nothing references the standalone body and the linker drops it -- while costing TView::TView(const TView&) 0x48bd30 63.92% -> 31.18%. In-class keeps that inlining. So in-class wins on every axis: identical (zero) pairing for this address, +32.74pp on the caller. Revisit only if a non-inlining caller appears. bd n2xl.
